name: stamp-app
description: Application de gestion de commandes - Backend + Frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run db:dev:ensure && STAMP_DB_PATH="$PWD/db/dev.db" concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
